claims.claim: The committed implementation delta changes exactly the nine authorized test-harness files and no files outside the permitted scope.

The implementation preserves the reusable immutable Git baseline/object construction, writable-state isolation, create-only/idempotent object behavior, real-Git follow-up conformance, and current-main TASK-155 compatibility embodied by the reusable RUN-154-007 candidate.
Deterministic fixture helpers selectively reduce setup-only Git state construction in test_operator.py and test_operator_unified_state.py while ambiguous sites remain on real Git.

Tests covering ancestry, refs, remotes, configuration semantics, dirty/index behavior, publication, transport, races, divergence, malformed lineage, and failure behavior retain production-shaped real-Git boundaries.

The implementation adds no optimization-motivated skip, xfail, deselection, test removal or rename, timeout inflation, broad Git mock, persistent shared mutable fixture state, parallel execution, or production semantic shortcut.

The implementation introduces no new semantic authority, automatic optimization selector, planner or router, retry or failover behavior, Reviewer decision, publication claim, or BP-V2 completion claim.
